description: cartesian_tree mod.rs: original algorithm and independent finite correspondence
cost: At most n pushes and n pops, O(n) lawful-Ord comparisons and O(n) storage: three link vectors and one stack. Comparison cost is external to this count; no timing gain is asserted.
forward: For each interval [lo,hi), choose the least index r attaining its minimum, recursively attach [lo,r) left and (r,hi) right. Empty interval gives None. The stack implements this tree: pop strictly greater suffixes, attach the last popped root as the new left child, then replace the surviving top's right child. Return explicit root/parent/left/right indices.
inverse: Typed behavior complement and ambiguous reverse reconstruction in model.md
limitations: Finite tests are not a proof; allocation refusal not injected; macros opaque and semantic AST absent
